Comment: conversation-analysis: transcript -> chunk -> render -> ONE waitForTaskToken submit to bedrock-inference (README.md §8, no polling) -> validate coverage -> merge. FIVE linear states, deliberately (2026-08-18): no in-machine coverage retry (bedrock owns transport retries; a caller rerun with a fresh idempotency_token is the semantic retry), no deadman Catch (a timed-out wait FAILS, and a REDRIVE of the submit state absorbs into the finished run and is woken synchronously - redrive IS the reconcile). Readability copy of the template's inline DefinitionString; edit BOTH, the build fails on drift.

Validate and plan.Comment: Everything that can refuse refuses HERE, before any inference dollar: transcript fetch+normalize (§7a), get_prompt (binds `default`, §1), model-chain validation against bedrock's registry (§7c), the §5 chunk plan, the §7b history scope. Persists _plan/plan.json; states pass URIs, never bodies (256 KB state I/O).

Render and stage.Comment: Per chunk: self-describing WebVTT envelope (§2) rendered through the copied prompt_render module, staged as records.jsonl under this run's prefix (§8: always staged, never inline).

Submit and wait.Comment: The §8 shape: ONE held state, NO polling. The handler invokes bedrock-inference's gateway Lambda inline (records_s3uri + callback_task_token + idempotency_token = THIS run's uuid) and writes the §7 history pointer from the TRUE submit response - the wake payload always carries a message, so history cannot be written after the wake. bedrock's waker completes the token with the terminal status as DATA (SendTaskSuccess even for FAILED). NO Catch, deliberately: a timeout FAILS the execution, and a REDRIVE of this state resubmits, absorbs into the (finished) run, and is completed SYNCHRONOUSLY by the gateway's absorbed-closed path - redrive IS the reconcile. A mid-flight retry of this task is equally safe: same uuid-token -> same bedrock workflow_id -> absorbed.

Collect and finalize.Comment: ONE state for both halves because nothing branches between them (2026-08-18): parse the JSONL output (§4), validate coverage per chunk (§3), then merge in pure code (§5-§6: continues_previous stitch, deterministic header vote, id -> authoritative timestamps) and write the analysis + chunk-manifest labels (§7e). Uncovered id ranges land in segments_gap HONESTLY - partial success is success; the rerun is the caller's fresh idempotency_token. A terminally FAILED bedrock run raises and propagates as itself - no Catch, no Fail state.

Usage tracking.Comment: Aggregates the run's summary/usage documents into the usage label. Success path only; the handler never raises - as the terminal state, an exception here would fail an execution whose products are already written.
